The lysate was then incubated with streptavidin-conjugated beads (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA) for 2 hours at 4°C. After washing with NETN buffer, the bound proteins were eluted with NETN buffer containing biotin (2 mg/ml; Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO) for 2 hours at 4°C. The eluates were then incubated with S-protein beads (EMD Millipore, Burlington, VT) for 4 hours. The beads were washed three times with NETN buffer and subjected to SDS-PAGE, followed by Coomassie blue staining. The whole band was excised and subjected to in-gel trypsin digestion and MS analysis.
